players.product: OSAT (incl. JCET STATS ChipPAC Korea) - package substrate buyer from Simmtech and Daeduck Electronics

quarterly_data.signal: CFO Liang Zheng (H1 2026 results briefing): raw-material prices have kept rising since last year, and the company has set up a price-linkage mechanism whose acceptance by customers keeps rising; at the same time it is stepping up capital spending in line with industry trends and customer demand, the value of advanced packaging in the industry chain keeps rising, and under a value-oriented, dynamically optimised pricing principle it is steering new capacity toward higher value-added output.
